title: Delete means redaction: a deleted message's text leaves the log
spec: SPEC.md section 3 requires this before the server accepts network connections: today a Deleted event is appended but the original Posted event (and every Edited event for it) still carries its html and mentions, so a sync from an older cursor returns text the author deleted. Implement EventLog::for_each_mut (visit held events oldest first with their cursors; head and len unchanged) and make RoomService::delete, after it succeeds, redact in place the Posted event at `target` and every Edited { target } event: html becomes empty and mentions become empty, while cursor, actor and kind stay (cursors must keep their meaning for clients that sync). Events of other messages are untouched. Delete the `#[allow(clippy::todo)]` on the stub. No new dependencies. Known limit, not part of this task: the durable journal (T140/T144) still holds the original Post operation until journal compaction exists; docs/SPEC.md notes it.
